descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S27 「没保存的查房前文字在切换模式后还在，且永远不出现在另一个模式的病历里」 Unsaved pre-round text survives a context switch and never appears in the other context's chart

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu …（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Fixture patients; the Hospital patient's Pre-Round tab

When Type 'MARK-H draft T21' in the Hospital pre-round box without Save Note, switch to Nursing Home and open the resident, then switch back and reopen the Hospital chart

Then The resident's chart never shows the draft (no bleed); the Hospital chart still has it (no lost work)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: checkpoint 1 mustNotContain the draft; checkpoint 2 mustContain it. The app has src/lib/localDrafts.ts and src/lib/useAutosave.ts. If Daniela answers Q9 that an explicit unsaved-changes warning is enough, checkpoint 2 is recalibrated to accept that message.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S27 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
